user_story: As a user, I want to be able to select a color from the 'Select Menu' so that I can filter items based on my preference. Acceptance Criteria: The user can select a color from the dropdown with id 'oldSelectMenu'. The available options are Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple, Black, White, Voilet, Indigo, Magenta, Aqua. Upon selection, the URL remains the same, and the selected color is displayed.
